description: Live intraday SELL-SIDE read on names you already hold: current-session trend state, hold strength, readiness, maturity-late flag, gap-risk grade, book regime, and watch_flags naming which deterioration conditions are true right now. Up to 10 symbols per call. Reports conditions only; it never reads your entry or size. Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. NVDA — or up to 10 comma-separated (NVDA,AMD,BTC-USD)
